title: Trade the number of independent ports for paid common-clock bandwidth
statement: For groups ofn_g bonds, max_g n_g/gamma_g->0 supplies phase replacement AND a positive exchange-form coefficient, including closed native gates. It permits independent gamma_N->infinity, group sizeL_N with gamma_N/L_N->infinity, or one clock with gamma_N/N->infinity. A weaker sufficient split is(1/N)sum n_g^2/gamma_g->0 plus liminf min gamma_g/n_g>0; native ellipticity can replace the latter. These are sufficient regimes, not a universal necessity threshold or a solved finite-ratio crossover.

The separate matching slow-common-clock SCALAR law needs its canonical or o(logN) conditional initial-entropy premise. Identical individual clock laws do not determine joint control correlations. Actual selective ports, common mean, full future conditional native-and-clock law, conservation, timing/sensing and vanishing reciprocal implementation errors are supplied, not acquired from finite observations.
